entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, agent ID 304. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand Pulse.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?

Thank you, Sarah. I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 15th. To get started, can I ask what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's fine. I just don't need it. I was going to call sooner but there was an emergency.
I'm sorry to hear that. I hope everything is okay.
My father had to have unexpected surgery. I've basically been living at the hospital for the last three weeks. So, returning this wasn't exactly my top priority.

Of course, I completely understand. Family comes first. Let me just pull up our policy for you... one moment. Okay, I see here that you're unfortunately outside the 10-day return window, so this is no problem at all. I can get that return started for you right now.
Oh. I was expecting a fight. My neighbor's son is on military deployment and he said getting any kind of help is a nightmare. Good to know it's not always like that.

We always try to make things as easy as possible for our customers. I've gone ahead and processed the return authorization. And I see here that you're a VIP member with VeloFit, Sarah. As a small thank you for your loyalty, I've also added a $25 credit to your account for any future purchase.
Whatever. Just send the return label.

Absolutely. I have just emailed that prepaid shipping label to the address on file. You can just print it, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. Will there be anything else for you today?
Alright. Well, thank you again for calling VeloFit. I hope your father has a swift recovery.
